title: Art set
description: Shape of presets/<mode>/art_sets/<id>.json. Loaded by presets.loadArtSet. Storage: folder entity. Catalog ids are genre tiles or objects. Prefer 1–4 entries per role (slim packs); roleId links tile_roles for bake/editor.

anchor.description: Draw pivot (creature-style). bottom_center for tall props; middle_center for terrain cells.

id.description: Genre catalog id. Designer Select follows the role: scenery/furniture → objects; terrain → tiles. Entry kind overrides (overlays for path/water families; objects + wallFamily for face walls). One family row uses representative *_wang_15 / *_pole. Alpha thumb (original fallback).

roleId.description: Relation: kind=tile_roles (presets_ids). Soft ref to presets/<mode>/tile_roles/ for bake + editor defaults.

kind.description: Catalog family. Default from the role key (scenery/furniture → objects; terrain → tiles). overlays = Wang path/water family. objects + wallFamily = P4 faces. Select writes this when you pick an asset.

wangFamily.description: Overlay family token. Set when kind is overlays. One art-set row per family; id is the representative *_wang_15. Empty = unset (omit on disk).

wallFamily.description: P4 wall-face family (e.g. stone_wall). Set when kind is objects and the stamp is a wall family. Empty = unset (omit on disk).

wallAlign.description: Representative wall face. Select writes pole; the brush resolves the other faces. Empty = unset (omit on disk).

render.description: Optional draw override for this row. Beats the linked role.render. MUST use this object — top-level scale/anchor/variant are not read.

influence.description: Optional partial gameplay override for this row. Authored keys beat the linked role.influence. Omitted keys inherit the role (hybrid bake) or the generator channel (procedural bind).

kind.description: Default catalog kind for entries that omit kind (usually tiles).

roles.description: Pick lists by decorative key. Procedural bind uses terrain keys only (floor/path/wall/stairs/void|water). Scenery/furniture are editor palette only.

oneOf.description: Genre tile catalog id. Designer: Select opens the tile catalog.
